description: Historic Environment Scotland publishes the national heritage designations of Scotland as open spatial data: listed buildings (points by category and boundaries), conservation areas, the Inventory of Gardens and Designed Landscapes, the Inventory of Historic Battlefields, scheduled monuments, World Heritage Sites, historic marine protected areas and properties in its care. Historic Environment Scotland compiles the statutory Inventory of Gardens and Designed Landscapes on behalf of Scottish Ministers; inventory status has no primary legislative protection but is a material consideration in planning. Coverage is the whole of Scotland. Access: an INSPIRE Atom download service with sub-feeds in GML and ESRI geodatabase formats in British National Grid and ETRS89, a combined web feature service of all designations, web map services and a shapefile for gardens and designed landscapes; entries are listed on data.gov.uk through the Scottish spatial data catalogue. Licence: the Atom feed states the Open Government Licence; the WFS notes Ordnance Survey derived data as an access constraint. Free. Caveats: boundaries derived from Ordnance Survey mapping; the data.gov.uk entries were last modified in June 2024. Simulation uses: heritage constraints on retrofit and adaptation, and exposure of listed buildings and designed landscapes to floods and heat. Related records: England conservation areas (planning.data.gov.uk) and the Scotland building standards register.
